item.title: The digitalisation of money, payments and finance

rating.summary: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone presented the Eurosystem's comprehensive payments strategy, covering the digital euro, tokenised central bank money (Pontes & Appia), and cross-border payment initiatives. The speech focused on the digitalisation of payments and financial infrastructure, including the digital euro's roadmap toward a potential 2029 issuance and the September 2026 launch of the Pontes platform. No discussion of interest rates, inflation, or monetary policy stance was included.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is entirely focused on payments infrastructure, digital finance, and tokenisation — not on monetary policy settings, rate decisions, or the economic outlook. It is therefore not a monetary policy speech.
key_quotes: The ECB aims to be ready for a potential first issuance of the digital euro during 2029.
Pontes & Appia will enable safe, efficient settlement in central bank money and support an integrated European market for digital assets from the outset.
